source_record.title: Senior Consultant Energy Markets & Economics (all genders)
source_record.description:
Your mission:

  • Preparation of market analyses, economic assessments and expert reports for PV, BESS and hybrid projects
  • Analysis of electricity markets, market mechanisms and regulatory frameworks within the European energy sector
  • Evaluation of business models, route-to-market strategies, as well as flexibility and energy storage solutions
  • Conducting cash flow, sensitivity and scenario analyses to support investment decisions
  • Presentation of results and strategic recommendations to clients, investors and project partners
  • Further development of existing consulting products and creation of new services in the field of Energy Markets & Economics
  • Collaboration in an international environment and close coordination with the Sales and Business Development teams


Your profile:

  • Successfully completed degree in Energy Economics, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Business Administration or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience in the energy sector, market analysis, management consulting or project development
  • In-depth knowledge of European electricity markets, energy market dynamics and regulatory requirements
  • Experience in developing financial models, economic assessments and data-driven decision-making frameworks
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex topics and communicate them effectively to different target audiences
  • High level of initiative, accountability, customer orientation and entrepreneurial mindset
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken


You can look forward to:

6 reasons to join meteocontrol (and more):

  1. Working for a better future: With us, you will create a better future for us and all generations after us.
  2. More flexibility: We know how important a good work-life balance is. That's why we offer flexible working hours and a home office model that adapts to your needs.
  3. Vacation that grows: Start with 30 days of vacation and your loyalty will be rewarded every two years with an additional day of vacation - up to 35 days for even more time off!
  4. Continuous learning & development: Your development is important to us - we support you in your career planning within the company with a wide range of offers.
  5. Money on top: In addition to your salary, you will receive a monthly SpenditCard worth €50 and a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.
  6. Fitness: Train with our attractive employer subsidy at EGYM Wellpass, take part in our JobRad leasing program or power yourself up at our annual company run.
... You can find many more reasons on our career website!
